title: Mixed7 Trio #05 (보태니컬+바디페인팅+스테인드글라스)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. THREE women standing side by side, each from a different Living Artifact track.

#1 (Botanical track): THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, mid 40s goddess, BBW bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — most massive full-figure BBW body ever at absolute maximum in every dimension, hips so wide beyond proportion dominating the entire frame, bust so enormous overwhelming gravity, waist deeply snatched despite impossible volume, hair threaded through with real trailing vines — full body living sakura growing directly from her own skin covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not a printed pattern, not a dress, every stem rooted directly into her living skin and every petal standing up in true three-dimensional relief casting its own small shadow, nothing lying flat. BLAZING PINK sakura blossoms in full three-dimensional bloom, VIVID GOLD leaves and curling tendrils filling every remaining gap with real depth and texture, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Pose: standing full height, both arms slightly spread commanding the frame — most extreme BBW bombshell silhouette ever displayed. Footwear: extreme platform heels entirely overgrown with the same living sakura blooms and vines, extra long nails with tiny petals embedded at each tip.

#2 (Bodypaint track): a real adult Korean woman in her early 50s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, flawless porcelain skin, soft rose-pink lips, delicate graceful eye makeup, cheerful, twin-tail hair, real living eyes. Long square nails, glittery finish. an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, her hips and rear so wide. A dramatically narrow, sharply cinched waist sits above hips and a rear so massively rounded and projecting that they dominate her entire silhouette from every angle — the rear itself curving outward and upward in a high, rounded, gravity-defying shape. A full round bust above the cinched waist, gigantic thick thighs meeting the rear's curve, thick soft arms. Her head looks small on top of her body. Not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Painted in Spanish Andalusian filigree (a deep black ground with fine silver filigree in geometric star patterns), wide silver bands following every deep crease, dense geometric star filigree filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted. Pose: kneeling on both knees, facing camera. Footwear: extreme silver extreme platform high heels.

#3 (Stained Glass track): THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, late 30s goddess, curvy petite physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — smallest most compact frame possible yet curves exploding at absolute maximum in every direction, bubble butt projecting dramatically backward from the tiny frame, thighs so thick they dwarf the petite frame, blunt collarbone-length bob thick heavy — full body stained glass covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is solid thick glass fused directly to her form, not a garment, made of hundreds of small individual panes each no larger than a coin, densely packed edge to edge, never large sheets, each tiny pane curving to follow her body's true shape with real physical thickness, dark lead-line seams webbing between every pane, each seam standing in a small raised ridge casting its own shadow, never flat. BLAZING ELECTRIC CRIMSON and VIVID GOLD panes alternating in a dense irregular mosaic, bright light passing through each tiny pane with sharp refraction glints, NO airbrush NO gradient wash. Pose: back three-quarter turned, face over shoulder direct eye contact, bubble butt projected backward — most extreme curvy petite silhouette ever displayed. Footwear: leaded-glass platform boots 8 inch, the same dense small-pane mosaic continuing onto the shoe, extra long stiletto nails to match.

MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours. Lighting: a single hard key light raking across all bodypaint/pregnant/irezumi/stained-glass/gold-leaf/botanical women from one side, realistic photographic grain where applicable, extreme high-gloss oil on maximalist tracks — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render; any UV Neon track woman additionally lit by her own dedicated UV blacklight spot. Pattern density maximum on all 3, zero bare skin from neck to ankle. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 4:5 aspect ratio.
